name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-06-15, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
